The '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One member of the species was a [[Unidentified hammerheaded fugitive|wanted fugitive]] by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
